home.destTitle: Where to Go With Your Rental
home.destSubtitle: The most popular destinations for tourists. Uzbekistan's roads make it comfortable to cover the entire Silk Road by car.
home.dest1Desc: Silk Road jewel. Registan Square, Shah-i-Zinda, Gur-Emir mausoleum. Perfect as a 2-day trip from Tashkent.
home.dest2Desc: Po-i-Kalyan minaret, Ark fortress, trading domes. Best reached via Samarkand with an overnight stop.
home.dest3Desc: Ichan-Kala open-air museum, UNESCO heritage. A long drive — we recommend an SUV for the desert leg.
home.dest4Desc: Ski resort in winter, trekking in summer. The closest mountain getaway from Tashkent — a great day trip.
home.dest5Desc: Kamchik Pass, Khudayar Khan Palace in Kokand, Margilan silk and Rishtan ceramics. Minimum 2-day trip.
home.dest6Desc: Alexander's fortress, a sacred spring and a vast desert lake. Yurt camps and camels — crossover required.
home.dest7Desc: Birthplace of Timur — UNESCO heritage. Ak-Saray palace ruins and the Takhta-Karacha pass. Best combined with Samarkand in 3 days.

faq.metaTitle: Car rental in Uzbekistan FAQ — documents, insurance, deposit
faq.metaDescription: Answers to common questions about renting a car in Tashkent: documents foreigners need, deposit amounts, third-party insurance, 300 km/day mileage allowance, airport delivery and rental terms.
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about renting a car with us in Uzbekistan.
faq.q1: How far in advance should I book?
faq.a1: We recommend booking at least 48 hours in advance, especially during peak tourist season (April–October). However, we can sometimes accommodate same-day bookings depending on availability.
faq.q2: Can I modify or cancel my reservation?
faq.a2: Yes! Free cancellation is available up to 24 hours before your pickup time. Modifications can be made anytime through our website or by contacting support.
faq.q3: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a3: We accept Visa, Mastercard, and cash (USD or UZS). Online payments are processed securely through our booking system.
faq.q4: Do I need an international driving license?
faq.a4: Yes, foreign nationals need a valid international driving permit (IDP) along with their national driver's license. We verify documents at pickup.
faq.q5: Is insurance included in the rental?
faq.a5: Yes, the rental price includes mandatory third-party liability insurance. If the car is damaged through the renter's fault, the cost is covered from the security deposit, which is refunded within 7–10 business days after the car is returned.
faq.a6: Absolutely. The mileage allowance is 300 km per day. Extra kilometres are charged separately, from 2,000 UZS per km. Popular routes: Tashkent–Samarkand (308 km), Samarkand–Bukhara (270 km), Chimgan and the Fergana Valley.
faq.q7: What happens if the car breaks down?
faq.a7: We provide 24/7 roadside assistance across Uzbekistan. Call our support line and we'll send help or a replacement vehicle as quickly as possible.
faq.a8: Our policy is full-to-full. You receive the car with a full tank and return it with a full tank. Fuel costs are not included in the rental price.
faq.q9: What is the minimum rental period?
faq.a9: The minimum period is 1 day (24 hours). Long-term discounts are negotiated individually — typically up to 10% off for 7+ days and up to 20% off for 30+ days.
faq.a10: Pickup and drop-off across Tashkent are free. Delivery to Tashkent International Airport (TAS) is 200,000 UZS (≈$15) during the day and 400,000 UZS (≈$30) at night. Share your flight time at booking and we'll meet you in arrivals with a name sign.
faq.q11: How much is the deposit and when is it refunded?
faq.a11: Deposit depends on class: Economy — 3,000,000 UZS, Comfort — 4,000,000 UZS, Premium — 5,000,000 UZS, Mercedes-Benz G400d — 10,000,000 UZS. It is refunded to the same card within 7–10 business days after the car is returned.
faq.q12: What is included in the price and what costs extra?
faq.a12: Included: third-party insurance, 300 km/day mileage, 24/7 support, free Tashkent delivery, pre-trip wash. Extra on request: GPS, Wi-Fi router, child seat, second driver (100,000 UZS), airport delivery.
faq.ctaSubtitle: Our friendly team is always happy to help. Reach out via phone, email, or visit our office in Tashkent.
